description: Chore registry - points to self-contained chore definitions resolved project-first under .gzkit/chores/<slug>/ with package fallback to importlib.resources.files('gzkit.chores')/<slug>/ per ADR-0.0.21.

lite.description: Gate-rigor: Gates 1, 2 required. Unit-tier only; no behave/network.

heavy.description: Gate-rigor: All gates required. Reserved for full-pipeline runs.

chores.title: ARB Pattern Extraction (Code Style Feedback Loop)

remediation.details: A recurring pattern is a candidate; the chore classifies each as auto-fixable, manual or structural and the operator decides whether it earns a work order.

chores.nonAuthority: Never edits source, lint configuration or a rule.

chores.title: CLI Contract Governance (Drift & Evolution)

remediation.details: Cosmetic and ergonomic drift (formatting, help-text clarity) is repaired in place; a breaking change (exit code, removed or renamed flag, changed behavior) lands only in an operator-initiated run.

chores.nonAuthority: Never changes an exit code, flag name or command behavior outside an operator-initiated run; never edits .gzkit/rules/cli.md to match drift.

chores.title: Complexity Reduction (Xenon C/C/C)

remediation.details: Refactor the functions over the xenon ceiling by extracting helpers and flattening nesting, keeping behavior and tests unchanged.

chores.nonAuthority: Never changes behavior, a public import, a CLI contract or a test's semantics; never suppresses a finding with noqa or an ignore comment. Never moves the gate from xenon C to the threshold table's block band; that conflict awaits an operator ruling.

chores.title: Config Paths Remediation

remediation.details: Replace hard-coded path literals with config-driven resolution until gz check-config-paths is clean.

chores.nonAuthority: Never changes behavior, a public import, a CLI contract or a test's semantics; never suppresses a finding with noqa or an ignore comment. Never exempts a literal it resolves by declaring it an audit subject.

chores.title: Control Surface Audit — Rule Prose vs. Permission Standing Consent (Pass D)

remediation.details: A live context-free row has a derivable fix: remove the allow rule or add a deny. Applied only in an operator-initiated run.

chores.nonAuthority: Never edits AGENTS.md or any rule; never touches a context-dependent or broad allow rule (Bash(gh issue:*) is load-bearing for /ghi-author); never applies the patch in an automatic run; never acquires a gz validate scope.

chores.title: Control Surface Audit — Rule-Pair Conflict Matrix (Pass A)

remediation.details: A rule conflict is a ruling. The chore recommends a resolution per row and stops; the operator rules, and the repair lands as a direct fix.

chores.nonAuthority: Never edits .gzkit/rules/**, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, a skill or source; resolving a conflict is the operator's ruling.

chores.title: Control Surface Audit — Rule Prose vs Promoted Check Parity (Pass C)

remediation.details: Whether to widen a check or narrow its prose is a ruling. The chore recommends one per non-parity row and stops.

chores.nonAuthority: Never edits .gzkit/rules/**, src/gzkit/commands/validate*, any check implementation or the advisory scorecard; closing a gap is an operator ruling landed as a direct fix.

chores.title: Control Surface Audit — Skill/Rule Reachability Matrix (Pass B)

remediation.details: Which of a skill or a rule still states intent is a ruling. The chore recommends reconcile skill, reconcile rule, promote check or accept gap per gap and stops.

chores.nonAuthority: Never edits .gzkit/skills/**, .gzkit/rules/**, vendor mirrors or source; the reconciliation direction is the operator's ruling.

chores.title: Control Surface Audit — Validator Reachability & Ungated Ratchet (Pass E)

remediation.details: Promote or retire is a ruling per scope. The chore emits a disposition per ungated scope and stops; the ratchet refuses growth.

chores.nonAuthority: Never edits src/gzkit/commands/validate* or any check; never wires a scope into a gate or deletes one itself; never re-baselines the ratchet upward.

chores.title: Coverage >=40% Baseline

remediation.details: Add table-driven behavior tests to low-coverage public modules until the floor holds.

chores.nonAuthority: Never lowers the floor, excludes a module from measurement, or adds a test that asserts a string rather than behavior.

chores.title: Cross-Platform Test Cleanup (Windows-Safe Patterns)

remediation.details: Replace raw shutil.rmtree teardown with TemporaryDirectory context managers.

chores.nonAuthority: Never changes what a test asserts; never skips a test on a platform to make it pass.

chores.title: Decommission Tautological Tests (ADR-0.0.59-04)

remediation.details: Apply each file's proposed disposition (convert, replace-with-ledger, fold-to-validator) and shrink the baseline to the new count.

chores.nonAuthority: Never re-baselines upward or adds a waiver to absorb a new operation; never deletes a test to reduce the count.

chores.title: Dependency Currency (Tooling Stack Drift Scan)

remediation.details: A bump deserves case-by-case judgment, so the chore recommends bump or hold per surface and the operator applies bumps through the gz-deps-upgrade skill.

chores.nonAuthority: Never bumps a dependency; never touches gzkit's own version surfaces or the requires-python floor.

chores.title: Documentation Cross-Coverage Enforcement

remediation.details: Create each missing documentation surface the manifest requires (manpage, index entry, runbook reference, docstring).

chores.nonAuthority: Never removes a manifest requirement to close a gap; never documents a command's behavior without running it.

chores.title: Evaluation Feedback Clustering (ADR-0.0.26)

remediation.details: Proposal records name a rule target; the operator decides, and a rule edit lands with its Eval-feedback-source trailer.

chores.nonAuthority: Never edits a rule, the ledger or docs/design/adr/**; never publishes a GHI.

chores.title: OBPI Evidence Integrity Audit

remediation.details: Evidence in a completed brief is a sealed record and OBPI briefs are operator-only, so the chore recommends a disposition per finding (repudiation, receipt re-emission, none) and stops.

chores.nonAuthority: Never edits an OBPI brief, ADR or the ledger; never repudiates or re-attests; those are operator-gated.

chores.title: Exceptions & Logging Rationalization

remediation.details: Replace bare and broad excepts with specific exception types, and operational print calls with logging.

chores.nonAuthority: Never changes behavior, a public import, a CLI contract or a test's semantics; never suppresses a finding with noqa or an ignore comment. Never widens an except at a non-boundary site.

chores.title: Failure-Class Index (GHI recurrence chains)

remediation.details: A chain is evidence a family recurs; the chore routes each live family to its owning surface and the operator decides the work order.

chores.nonAuthority: Never edits, files or closes a GHI; never commits the corpus snapshot.

chores.title: Frontier Model Card Currency (System-Card Doctrine Refresh)

remediation.details: Re-source or retire doctrine pinned to a superseded card and rotate the registry, as a GHI-tracked direct doc fix in an operator-initiated run.

chores.nonAuthority: Never rewrites doctrine in an automatic run; never consumes a card from secondary reporting; never keeps a superseded card for reference.

chores.title: Frontmatter-Ledger Reconciliation (ADR-0.0.16 OBPI-03)

remediation.details: Rewrite drifted id/parent/lane/status frontmatter to the ledger value; the ledger is Layer-2 truth.

chores.nonAuthority: Never edits the ledger, an ungoverned frontmatter key, or a pool ADR; stops with zero files mutated on an unmapped status term.

chores.title: Config-First Enforcement (Anti-Vibe-Code)

remediation.details: Thread config-resolved paths and thresholds through parameters in place of module constants and parents walks.

chores.nonAuthority: Never changes behavior, a public import, a CLI contract or a test's semantics; never suppresses a finding with noqa or an ignore comment. Never declares a resolved literal an audit subject to silence the check.

chores.title: Instructions & Memory Files Diet (Progressive Disclosure)

remediation.details: Lift and compress the items the operator ruled, through the corpus and canonical rule sources, until the rendered surface fits its cap.

chores.nonAuthority: Never edits a rendered surface or vendor mirror; never trims a tier: invariant entry or a Mechanical or Promotable bullet; never acts on an item the operator did not rule.

chores.title: Ledger Vocabulary Inertness — never-fired types and paired-event ratios

remediation.details: Whether a never-fired type is wired, retired or disclosed is a ruling; the chore recommends one per type, reads each lopsided pair to its producer, and stops.

chores.nonAuthority: Never edits the schema, the ledger or any producer; never re-baselines disclosure upward; never interprets a ratio.

chores.title: Audit auto-memory for process drift into governed artifacts

remediation.details: Migrate process-encoding memories into their governed source (corpus, rule or skill) and remove stale memory files, in an operator-initiated run.

chores.nonAuthority: Never edits a rendered surface (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .claude/**); never removes user or reference memories.

chores.title: Module SLOC Cap (Radon)

remediation.details: Split over-band modules by cohesion, keeping public imports stable, and surrender grandfather entries that fall under the band.

chores.nonAuthority: Never adds a grandfather entry to absorb a new violation or raises a listed ceiling; never states a threshold outside complexity-thresholds.json.

chores.title: PEP 257 Docstring Compliance (Style + Coverage)

remediation.details: Add missing docstrings and fix ruff D-series violations.

chores.nonAuthority: Never lowers the interrogate threshold or ignores a D rule to pass.

chores.title: Pool ADR Drift Triage (read-only; stopgap for ADR-pool.pool-management)

remediation.details: Archival and promotion are operator acts (git mv; the gz adr promote ceremony), so the chore recommends an action per finding and stops.

chores.nonAuthority: Never writes to docs/design/adr/pool/, the ledger or any governance artifact; never ranks pool items.

chores.title: Pythonic Design Pattern Application (Before/After Evidence Capture)

remediation.details: Apply a detected Pythonic rewrite under TDD with before/after complexity and SLOC evidence.

chores.nonAuthority: Never applies a rewrite with no detection row, regresses xenon, or bundles two rewrites in one evidence file.

chores.title: Pythonic Design Pattern Detection (AST Scanner + refactoring.guru Catalogue)

remediation.details: The repair is the paired pythonic-design-pattern-application chore; detection records a disposition per candidate and stops.

chores.nonAuthority: Never edits source; never marks a candidate not-pythonic-rewrite without reading the example and naming the reason.

chores.title: Pythonic Refactoring (ruff + ty)

remediation.details: Apply ruff safe fixes and hand Pythonic rewrites until ruff and ty are clean.

chores.nonAuthority: Never changes behavior, a public import, a CLI contract or a test's semantics; never suppresses a finding with noqa or an ignore comment. Never uses --unsafe-fixes.

chores.title: Run full quality gates

remediation.details: A gate failure has no single repair; the chore names the chore or direct fix that owns each failing gate and stops.

chores.nonAuthority: Never skips a gate, adds a waiver or suppression, or re-runs a failing step until it passes by chance.

chores.title: Repository Structure Normalization

remediation.details: Create missing directories and move misplaced files to the layout gz validate --documents --surfaces expects.

chores.nonAuthority: Never changes behavior or file content while moving it; never edits a validator to accept a deviation.

chores.title: Ground-Truth Correction Mining (ADR-0.0.70)

remediation.details: Proposals are candidates for the advisory scorecard; nothing auto-promotes.

chores.nonAuthority: Never writes outside its proofs directory; never quotes more than one scrubbed line.

chores.title: Skill Authoring Quality (Agent-First Best Practices)

remediation.details: Skills are operator-authored canon, so the chore records the action each skill needs and stops; any fix it recommends must preserve behavior.

chores.nonAuthority: Never edits .gzkit/skills/** or a vendor mirror.

chores.title: Skill & Command Documentation Parity

remediation.details: Missing, orphaned and index or runbook gaps are repaired in documentation; aligning a skill's purpose statement lands only in an operator-initiated run, because skills are operator-authored canon.

chores.nonAuthority: Never edits .gzkit/skills/** outside an operator-initiated run; never edits vendor mirrors; never removes a command to close a doc gap.

chores.title: Skill Trigger & Output Testing

remediation.details: Skills are operator-authored canon, so the chore proposes replacement description and output-contract text per flagged skill and stops.

chores.nonAuthority: Never edits .gzkit/skills/** or a vendor mirror.

chores.title: Test Consolidation — subTest Sweep & Slow-Tier Quarantine (GHI #644)

remediation.details: Convert looping table-driven tests to subTest and route duplicated setUp bodies through the shared fakes, keeping the test count.

chores.nonAuthority: Never deletes a test or reduces the test count; never changes CANONICAL_STEP_COMMANDS or re-pins unittest-parallel.

chores.title: Test Isolation & Health Compliance

remediation.details: Fix each isolation, speed or stdout-noise violation at its root cause (shared setup, mocked roots, patched console).

chores.nonAuthority: Never masks a slow test with sleep or clock hacks, or loosens a profiler threshold to pass.

chores.title: Test Manpage Examples (Executable Verification)

remediation.details: Replace each manpage example whose output no longer matches with output captured from a real run.

chores.nonAuthority: Never edits the CLI to match a stale example; a behavior change the example expected is an operator ruling.

chores.title: Validate Manpages (Call Stack Alignment)

remediation.details: Update manpage implementation traces to the functions that exist.

chores.nonAuthority: Never renames or restores source to match a stale trace.
